style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

American PrometheusAs the USA have Robert Oppenheimer complete the Manhattan Project.
Robert Oppenheimer has completed the special project ⟦0⟧

Build Nuclear Research Facilities and hire scientists to man them. Rush down to Manhattan project, you get there the fastest by choosing ⟦0⟧. Research Atomic Research as well as all computing research ahead of time. You can also go for radar research to increase physics breakthroughs. Assign whatever Scientists to Pile-1 Nuclear Reactor, but you MUST choose Oppenheimer for The Manhattan Project. Make sure to check out iterations and decisions during the research. If an event comes up asking you to decide whether to keep or dismiss Oppenheimer from the project, keep him. Once the project completes, the achievement pops.
